latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Image to Video Clip:

- Instantly turn uploaded images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC, up to 200MB) into 1080p MP4 video clips using a cloud AI pipeline.
- Seamless user flow: upload images, give a short instruction (e.g., "turn these images into a 15-second video clip with smooth transitions"), and download the result.
- Automatic session and authentication setup, with 100 free credits on first use; no manual token entry required.
- Supports fast export, status tracking, credit checking, and real-time progress updates.
- Designed for social media creators — no complex editing, just fast, AI-powered results.
